notes: Writer's doubts settled: Laney's falafel job is in the film. Zack visits her at work 'where she wears a falafel on her head' and Dean later visits her at 'Laney's falafel ball job' (Pajiba liveblog, with timestamps), and Wikipedia's production section names the falafel restaurant hat. 'Harrison High' is not printed anywhere (venue is 'The Senior Prom'), so nothing to fix; no page I opened names the school. Six weeks, the hacky sack at the performance piece, the beach, Mack's makeover, the foghorn, the cap and soccer ball (Wikipedia) and the vapor and spam, breakfast and first dance lines (Wikiquote) all hold. Every printed dish line is a stub with no food in it.

vibe.verdict: Every dish now prints a real food line, but the notes are still short fragments and the prom card itself stays generic.
